answers.core: This requires changes in the editor code, like the disabling of `PackedData` mentioned above, but other parts of the editor, like the FileSystem dock and the resource loader would need to be able to handle remapped files. These changes cannot be made with an add-on.
answers.workaround: No. The `PackedData` class is disabled in the editor so resource packs can't be loaded by scripts or plugins.
